final_report.thought: Req_2 is implemented and the existing tests pass. Req_1 stays unimplemented because tests/test_api_freeze.py blocks adding sign_path_token pending security review.
final_report.notes: Added verify_path_token(secret, path, expires_at, token, now) to src/signed_url.py. It rejects expired tokens (now > expires_at), recomputes the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over f'{path}:{int(expires_at)}', and compares with hmac.compare_digest. expiry_remaining is unchanged. req_1 (sign_path_token) was not added: tests/test_api_freeze.py flags it as a frozen public surface (GH-T33) pending security review, so it needs that review or an explicit freeze exception before it can be implemented. The 2 existing tests pass. The new verify function has no dedicated test yet.
